description: This Java source file defines the 'AttributeModified' class, representing an event emitted after a Thing's attribute is modified within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for constructing instances, JSON serialization/deserialization, and accessors for event details.

classes.name: AttributeModified
classes.description: Represents an event emitted after a Thing's attribute has been modified, including details such as attribute pointer, value, revision, timestamp, headers, and metadata.

methods.name: getAttributeValue

methods.description: Returns the entity (attribute value) as an Optional, considering schema version.
